description:
ABOUT CARTESIA

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Cartesia builds real-time multimodal intelligence: fast, state-of-the-art voice models and the products that make them useful. We started as a research lab, pioneered the state space model architecture, and now we're bringing that research to customers through intuitive tools for creating, testing, and shipping with voice.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Voices team. Every conversation powered by Cartesia starts with a voice. The Voices team builds how customers find, clone, and design voices that sound right for their product, in any language.

The work reaches across the company. You’ll work closely with:

 - Research: Turn new model capabilities into product features, such as turning voices multilingual and steering voices to match the ideal profile.

 - Platform and infra: Serve every voice reliably at the scale of our API traffic.

 - On-prem: Build adaptable interfaces and systems so that voices are available and compatible in a variety of settings and hardware.

 - Customer-facing teams: Help every customer get a great voice on their own.




YOUR IMPACT

 - Build polished product experiences for finding, cloning, and designing voices, from the first listen to a voice running in production.

 - Design the APIs developers build on, so every capability is as easy to use in code as it is in the product.

 - Turn early research into features customers use every day, like voice cloning, localization, and voice design.

 - Build the backend systems that train, store, and serve custom voices at scale, in the cloud and on-prem.

 - Raise the quality bar for every voice we launch, with internal tools, automated evaluations, and analytics that show how voices sound and perform.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 3+ years of experience building and operating customer-facing software in production, ideally at a high-growth startup, including owning systems that serve high traffic reliably. We care more about what you’ve shipped and kept running at scale than strict years of experience.

 - Strong product instincts: you think in customer outcomes, usability, quality, and developer experience, and you have opinions on what to build and why.

 - Full-stack range and the ability to own a product surface across frontend, backend, APIs, data, and operational concerns.

 - Fluent use of coding agents and a habit of keeping pace with the frontier.

 - Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, strong cross-functional partnership, and a sharp presence in product and design reviews.
   
   


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience building developer tools, creative tools, playgrounds, or API-adjacent products.

 - Experience building AI-powered products and translating model capabilities, limitations, and quality tradeoffs into understandable user experiences.

 - Strong frontend craft with React and TypeScript, including polished, highly interactive workflows.

 - Experience with audio, media, real-time systems, product analytics, experimentation, or evaluation infrastructure.

 - Working familiarity with deploying, monitoring, and troubleshooting services on Kubernetes, especially in multi-cluster setups



Note: Cartesia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I-9 information to confirm employment eligibility after hire.




MORE DETAILS

🏢 In-office policy: We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.

🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case-by-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.

🚢 We ship fast. All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way.

🤝 We support each other. We have an open & inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed.




OUR BENEFITS (US EMPLOYEES ONLY) 

💰 Compensation Competitive base salary alongside attractive equity package.

🩺 Health Insurance Fully covered medical insurance along with dental and vision for you and your family.

🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Parental Leave 9 weeks paternity & 12 weeks maternity leave 

🏦 401(k)

🚆 Commuter Allowance A monthly stipend to help you get to and from the office.

🏖️ Flexible PTO Take as much time as you need to recharge your batteries.

🍲 Meals & Snacks Lunch, dinner and plenty of snacks, provided daily.

🦖 Your own personal Yoshi




OUR COMMITMENT TO EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Cartesia is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.
